_comment: Provenance of every vendored third-party library. MV3 forbids remote code, so
these ship inside the package; AMO therefore asks for their sources and for an
account of any change we made. This file is the single source of truth for that:
the Firefox build renders it into the reviewer notes, and tests/vendor.test.js
verifies the recorded hashes against the files on disk, so neither the libraries
nor this description can drift without the suite failing.
sha256 values are over the file with LF line endings, so a Windows checkout that

jspdf.umd.min.js.name: jsPDF
modifications: Removed the one remote-code loader: the string "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdfobject/2.1.1/pdfobject.min.js" is replaced with an empty string. jsPDF injects that <script> only in its output('dataurlnewwindow') mode, which this extension never calls; loading remote code is forbidden by both MV3 and AMO policy. Verified to be the ONLY difference from upstream — every other byte is identical.
